title: Brutal Doom
description: Brutal Doom is a gameplay mod inspired by the Doom comic that revamps the original monsters and weapons. It introduces elaborate gore effects, fatalities, headshots, dynamic fluids, and verbal taunts. Combat mechanics are expanded with kick attacks, rebalanced firearms with secondary fire modes, and optional weapon reloading.
